prompt: The video begins with the viewer moving along a stone path bordered by lush greenery and tall pine trees under a bright, sunny sky. As the movement continues, the perspective shifts towards a stone building partially obscured by foliage, before veering back into the dense forest. The camera navigates through narrow, winding trails surrounded by towering evergreens and patches of wildflowers, capturing the intricate textures of the forest floor and the interplay of light and shadow. The scene remains consistently empty, emphasizing the serene and untouched nature of the location. Throughout the sequence, the camera maintains a steady, forward-moving angle, providing a continuous and immersive view of Le Prarion's diverse landscapes, from open, sunlit areas to the cool, shadowed depths of the woodland. The vivid greens of the trees and grass contrast sharply with the earthy tones of the paths and stones, enhancing the visual richness of the environment.
